effect.name: message
effect.description: Sends the player a text, its {variables} and %placeholders% filled.

params.name: text
params.description: The text sent.

effect.name: command
effect.description: Runs a command, its {variables} filled, as the console or, with as: player, as the player. For an offline player it runs now from the console, or waits for the login under as: player; offline: overrides both.

params.name: command
params.description: The command, without the leading /.

effect.name: set
effect.description: Sets a variable that can be written to an amount.

params.name: variable
params.description: The variable written, e.g. food.

params.name: amount
params.description: The value written: a number, a text, true or false.

effect.name: add
effect.description: Adds an amount to a numeric variable that can be written; a negative amount takes.

params.name: variable
params.description: The variable written, e.g. exp-points.

params.name: amount
params.description: The number added.

effect.name: teleport
effect.description: Teleports the player to a point of a world.

params.name: world
params.description: The world's name.

params.name: x
params.description: X.

params.name: y
params.description: Y.

params.name: z
params.description: Z.

effect.name: gamemode
effect.description: Changes the player's game mode; holdable.

params.name: value
params.description: The game mode.

effect.name: fly
effect.description: Lets the player fly, or takes it away and lands them; holdable.

params.name: value
params.description: Whether the player may fly.

effect.name: potion-effect
effect.description: Gives the player an effect for a time; holdable.

params.name: effect
params.description: The platform's effect id, e.g. speed.

params.name: level
params.description: The level, from 1.

params.name: duration
params.description: How long it lasts.

effect.name: player-time
effect.description: Shows the player a time of day of their own (ticks, 0 = 06:00), fixed or running from it; holdable.

params.name: value
params.description: The time in ticks, 0 to 24000.

params.name: relative
params.description: Whether the clock keeps running from it.

effect.name: player-weather
effect.description: Shows the player a weather of their own; holdable.

params.name: value
params.description: The weather, e.g. clear or rain.

effect.name: money
effect.description: Gives an amount of a currency to the owner's wallet.

params.name: amount
params.description: The amount: a number, or a {variable}.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency, e.g. money or finaleconomy:gold.

effect.name: give-item
effect.description: Gives the player an item through to: (the inventory by default); what does not fit waits as a pending delivery.

params.name: item
params.description: The item's id, e.g. minecraft:iron_ingot.

params.name: amount
params.description: How many.

params.name: data
params.description: The data value - the colour of a pre-1.13 wool (minecraft:wool with 14 is red), a tool's damage; -1 for any.

params.name: expires
params.description: How long what did not fit waits to be claimed; without it, until claimed.

effect.name: open-screen
effect.description: Opens the screen a key names for the player - whatever override answers it, else the core's default.

params.name: screen
params.description: The screen key, owner:name - e.g. evernifecore:deliveries.

params.name: args
params.description: What {0}..{n} read in the screen's text; each one has its {variables} filled.

effect.name: start-quest
effect.description: Starts a quest for the context's owner.

params.name: quest
params.description: The quest, owner:name (a bare name is the caller's own).

effect.name: offer-quest
effect.description: Offers a quest to the context's owner.

params.name: quest
params.description: The quest, owner:name (a bare name is the caller's own).

effect.name: complete-quest
effect.description: Completes the context's owner's active quest.

params.name: quest
params.description: The quest, owner:name (a bare name is the caller's own).

effect.name: fail-quest
effect.description: Fails the context's owner's active quest.

params.name: quest
params.description: The quest, owner:name (a bare name is the caller's own).

effect.name: track-quest
effect.description: Makes the player track a quest.

params.name: quest
params.description: The quest, owner:name (a bare name is the caller's own).

effect.name: start-dialogue
effect.description: Starts a registered dialogue for the player; the caller of the context becomes the session's origin and an npc attribute of the context its NPC. A dialogue the player was in ends as replaced.

params.name: dialogue
params.description: The dialogue, owner:name - e.g. finalcolonies:tomas.

params.name: node
params.description: The node to start on instead of the dialogue's entry.

effect.name: end-dialogue
effect.description: Ends the dialogue the player is in, if any.

effect.name: open-menu
effect.description: Opens a registered menu for the player - on top of the screen a click came from, so back returns there.

params.name: menu
params.description: The menu id, owner:name - e.g. finalmenus:shop-vip.

params.name: args
params.description: What {0}..{n} read in the menu's text; each one has its {variables} filled.

condition.name: all
condition.description: Passes when every condition passes; a failure lists every condition that failed.

params.name: conditions
params.description: The conditions combined.

condition.name: any
condition.description: Passes when at least one condition passes.

params.name: conditions
params.description: The conditions combined.

params.name: conditions
params.description: The conditions combined.

condition.name: at-least
condition.description: Passes when at least count of the conditions pass.

params.name: count
params.description: How many conditions must pass.

params.name: conditions
params.description: The conditions combined.

condition.name: optional
condition.description: Always passes; when its condition fails, the failure is shown as a note.

params.name: condition
params.description: The condition reported.

condition.name: compare
condition.description: Compares a variable with an amount: numbers with < <= = >= > !=, texts with = != contains, true/false with = !=.

params.name: variable
params.description: The variable read, e.g. exp-level or finaljobs:level.

params.name: op
params.description: How to compare.

params.name: amount
params.description: What the variable is compared with: a number, a text, true or false.

condition.name: permission
condition.description: Passes when the player has a permission node.

params.name: node
params.description: The permission node, e.g. shop.vip.

condition.name: repeat
condition.description: Takes one use of a counter of the context's owner - a limit, a gap between uses, a window that starts the count over - and gives it back when a later cost does not come out.

params.name: counter
params.description: The counter's id within the plugin, e.g. vip-door.

params.name: limit
params.description: Uses allowed, per window when one is set; none is unlimited.

params.name: cooldown
params.description: The least time between two uses, e.g. 10m.

params.name: window
params.description: When the count starts over, e.g. daily at 04:00.

params.name: reach
params.description: Where a player's or the server's counter lives.

params.name: persistent
params.description: Whether it outlives a restart; by default only a limit does.

condition.name: money
condition.description: Takes an amount of a currency from the owner's wallet; gives it back when a later cost does not come out.

params.name: amount
params.description: The amount: a number, or a {variable}.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency, e.g. money or finaleconomy:gold.

condition.name: item
condition.description: Takes matching items from the player's inventory; hands them back when a later cost does not come out.

params.name: item
params.description: The item's id, e.g. minecraft:diamond; a bare name matches any namespace.

params.name: amount
params.description: How many.

params.name: data
params.description: The data value - the colour of a pre-1.13 wool (minecraft:wool with 14 is red), a tool's damage; -1 for any.

condition.name: near-npc
condition.description: Passes while the player stands near an NPC, in the same world.

params.name: npc
params.description: The NPC as provider:id, e.g. citizens:12 or znpcsplus:merchant.

params.name: radius
params.description: How many blocks away still counts as near.

condition.name: in-region
condition.description: Passes while the player stands in a region (by id) or in any region with a tag; with for-at-least, only once they stood there that long without leaving.

params.name: region
params.description: The region, owner:name; a bare name is the caller's own.

params.name: tag
params.description: Any region with this tag.

params.name: for-at-least
params.description: How long inside, without leaving, e.g. 5m.

condition.name: region-flag
condition.description: Passes when a flag resolves, where the player stands, to a value.

params.name: flag
params.description: The flag, e.g. evernifecore:pvp.

params.name: equals
params.description: The value it resolves to, as written in a region, e.g. deny.

condition.name: region-member
condition.description: Passes when the player belongs to a group local to a region.

params.name: region
params.description: The region, owner:name; a bare name is the caller's own.

params.name: group
params.description: The region's group, e.g. members.

condition.name: quest-status
condition.description: Whether the owner stands at a status of a quest: AVAILABLE, ACTIVE, COMPLETED...

params.name: quest
params.description: The quest, owner:name (a bare name is the caller's own).

params.name: is
params.description: The status.

variable.name: gamemode
variable.description: The player's game mode: survival, creative, adventure or spectator.

variable.name: playtime
variable.description: How long the player has played on this server.

variable.name: permission
variable.description: Whether the player has a permission node.

params.name: node
params.description: The permission node, e.g. shop.vip.

variable.name: placeholder
variable.description: A text with %placeholders% filled for the player.

params.name: text
params.description: The text, e.g. %vault_eco_balance%.

variable.name: custom
variable.description: A plugin's own variable, one value per owner, by the id it was defined with (plugin:name).

params.name: id
params.description: The variable's id, e.g. fakeshop:daily-money-earned.

variable.name: stat
variable.description: A statistic of the platform by its native name, e.g. PLAY_ONE_MINUTE on Bukkit.

params.name: name
params.description: The statistic's native name.

variable.name: region-time
variable.description: How long the player has stood in a region without leaving it; zero outside.

params.name: region
params.description: The region, owner:name; a bare name is the caller's own.

variable.name: quest-times
variable.description: How many times the owner completed a quest.

params.name: quest
params.description: The quest, owner:name (a bare name is the caller's own).

variable.name: gold
variable.description: The balance in gold of the context's owner.

eligibility.name: completed-objective
eligibility.description: The members who contributed to an objective of the quest being paid.

params.name: id
params.description: The objective's id in the quest, e.g. mobs.

eligibility.name: any-member
eligibility.description: Every member of the owner, offline included, and whoever contributed while the leaver keeps.

eligibility.name: online
eligibility.description: The members online when the reward pays.

eligibility.name: present
eligibility.description: The members standing in the owner's region or world; the online ones for a group or a player.

eligibility.name: last-actor
eligibility.description: Only whose action closed it, as the caller names it; nobody when it names none.

eligibility.name: role
eligibility.description: The group's leader (role: leader) or the members holding a role of the group's kind. Group owners only.

params.name: role
params.description: leader, or the name of a role of the group's kind.

eligibility.name: contribution-at-least
eligibility.description: The members who contributed at least this much.

params.name: min
params.description: The least contribution, e.g. 1.

eligibility.name: contribution-share
eligibility.description: The members who contributed at least this part of the fair share (total / contributors).

params.name: at-least
params.description: A part of the fair share: 60% or 0.6.

eligibility.name: top
eligibility.description: The members with the highest contributions.

params.name: count
params.description: How many, e.g. 3.

eligibility.name: condition
eligibility.description: The members for whom a condition passes.

params.name: condition
params.description: The condition, run for the member.

eligibility.name: mark
eligibility.description: The participants of the scene carrying a mark; only on a rule read under an occasion that declares it.

params.name: mark
params.description: A mark the occasion declares, e.g. alive.

eligibility.name: any-of
eligibility.description: The members at least one of the listed eligibilities accepts.

params.name: of
params.description: The eligibilities, e.g. [{type: mark, mark: mvp}, {type: top, count: 3}].

eligibility.name: not
eligibility.description: The members the given eligibility does not accept.

params.name: of
params.description: The eligibility turned around, e.g. {type: mark, mark: alive}.

distribution.name: each
distribution.description: The whole reward to every eligible member.

distribution.name: split-equal
distribution.description: The reward split equally among the eligible.

distribution.name: top-takes-all
distribution.description: The whole reward to the highest contribution.

distribution.name: tiers
distribution.description: A part of the reward per position, highest contribution first; positions past the list get nothing.

params.name: tiers
params.description: The part of each position, e.g. [50%, 30%, 20%].

absence.name: deliver
absence.description: An offline member's share waits as a pending delivery.

absence.name: forfeit
absence.description: An offline member's share is lost.

absence.name: redistribute
absence.description: An offline member's share is split among the online eligible.

moment.name: on-complete
moment.description: Pays when what it was for is done.

moment.name: on-window-end
moment.description: Pays when its time window closes.

moment.name: on-owner-gone
moment.description: Pays, in part, when its owner is gone.

membership.name: membership
membership.description: Whether a member who left keeps a contribution, and whether one who joined late inherits.

params.name: leaver
params.description: keeps or forfeits.

params.name: joiner
params.description: from-now or inherits-zero.

effect-modifiers.name: delay
effect-modifiers.description: Waits this long before applying the effect.

effect-modifiers.name: chance
effect-modifiers.description: From 0 (never) to 1 (always): how likely the effect applies.

effect-modifiers.name: if
effect-modifiers.description: A condition that must pass for the effect to apply.

effect-modifiers.name: repeat
effect-modifiers.description: How many times the effect runs; more than 1 needs every.

effect-modifiers.name: every
effect-modifiers.description: The time between the runs of repeat.

effect-modifiers.name: as
effect-modifiers.description: Who runs it, for an effect that takes a sender (command).

effect-modifiers.name: scope
effect-modifiers.description: held lasts only while the condition that gave it holds.

effect-modifiers.name: to
effect-modifiers.description: The delivery destination, for an effect that takes one, e.g. pending.

effect-modifiers.name: offline
effect-modifiers.description: With the player offline: apply now, skip it, or wait for the next login; a command run as: player waits by default.
